notes.body: Periderm refers to native periderm unless specifically identified as wound periderm. Skin set is being framed as native periderm maturation.
Central interpretation: irrigation withdrawal accelerated native periderm maturation rather than simply inducing a generalized water-deficit response.
The Australian publication should be grounded in native periderm biology and focused on the field-to-market production chain rather than long-term storage.
The prototype began with GDD, crop stage, weather, and predicted US No. 1 yield; later concepts added harvest readiness and skinning risk.
Classification integrates responsiveness, nutrient-use efficiency, marketable yield grades, gene-expression evidence, and partial-budget economics.
Primary purpose: make it possible to resume a project quickly without reconstructing the history from multiple chats and files.
